card.line: Ariel is a symbolic name for Jerusalem, the city where David camped. In Isaiah, God warns it of coming trouble and promises to rescue it from its enemies.

moments.title: Woe to Ariel
moments.text: God says woe to Ariel, the city where David camped. He will constrain her, and there will be mourning and lamentation, and she will be like an altar hearth before Him.

moments.title: Enemies Like a Dream
moments.text: The LORD of Hosts comes with thunder, earthquake, and fire. The many nations that attack Ariel will be like a dream, a vision in the night.
